sessions.summary: v0.9.0: Mi cuenta page (password change direct or via email confirmation link), /reset-password recovery page, security recommendation banner, Sidebar link. Fixed create-agent 401 (anon key → user JWT). Ported WhatsApp gateway to wa-gateway Edge Function and deployed it plus create-agent to Supabase. whatsapp-gateway/ marked deprecated (R5). | v0.9.1: root-caused production 406s — asistente_real_state schema was not exposed to PostgREST and anon/authenticated lacked USAGE/table grants; fixed via migration (grants + pgrst.db_schemas + reload). Added dark mode (tokens, sidebar toggle, card/modal theming) and improved sidebar text contrast. | v0.9.2: production UI rendered unstyled — postcss.config.js was missing so Next.js never ran Tailwind (raw @tailwind/@apply shipped to browser; only native @layer CSS vars worked). Added config, verified compiled CSS contains utilities/preflight/dark tokens.
commits: feat(security+wa): password change w/ email confirmation, wa-gateway edge function
fix(api)+feat(ui): expose schema in Data API, dark mode
fix(build): add postcss.config.js so Tailwind compiles
